analysis_role: Answer-free Q-Zoom ROI policy inference before paired Effect freeze

policy.policy_prompt_suffix: Answer the question using a single word or phrase.

declared_adaptations.flash_attention_2_to_sdpa: The official repository provides an SDPA evaluation path; the installed FlashAttention binary requires unavailable GLIBC_2.32.
declared_adaptations.skimage_to_scipy: The sole skimage.measure.label call is replaced by scipy.ndimage.label with an all-ones 3x3 structure, preserving 8-connected components.
declared_adaptations.gate_bypass: The learned dynamic gate is ignored so every frozen trigger question receives two policy views and the paired trigger set remains identical.
declared_adaptations.answer_head_bypass: Only one model forward is run to materialize the SD-RPN ROI; Q-Zoom answer generation is never executed.

selection_and_fallback.question_trigger: At least one of the two frozen anchors produces a valid official ROI.
selection_and_fallback.roi_anchor_view: Use the exact persisted official ROI PNG as one 896 detail view at the same anchor time.
selection_and_fallback.no_roi_anchor: Use the frozen AVFunnel-mid bbox at the same anchor.
selection_and_fallback.structural_or_runtime_error: Hard policy failure; no retry and no Effect protocol.

next_freeze: After 200 policy requests complete, merge without filtering, freeze exact triggered paired inputs and fairness invariants, then authorize Clean Qwen3 A2 before loading Screen references.
